sources.title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models
sources.snippet: TL;DR Long-WAM scales the visual history of a causal world-action model and keeps it real-time. Autoregressive video pretraining turns longer context into better control, and a co-designed runtime runs the full predict-then-act model at 107.4 ms per action chunk on an RTX 5090, with deployment on DGX Spark and Jetson AGX Thor.

sources.title: AIAny - Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models
sources.snippet: Scales visual history for real-time robot control by combining autoregressive video pretraining with a streaming, asynchronous predict-then-act pipeline; shows longer context improves long-horizon manipulation and runs full inference in 107.4 ms per action chunk on an RTX 5090.
